name: Ynadar Initiate Package
desc: A set of blueprints that allows assembly of basic Ynadar hulls ranging from the dedicated missile frigate to its long-range scanner cruiser.

name: Ynadar Traveller Package
desc: A set of blueprints that allows assembly of baseline Ynadar hulls ranging from a time-compressed frigate to their signature mainline battlecruiser.

name: Ynadar Arsenal Package
desc: This design chip is comprised of the standard long-ranged Ynadar weapon blueprints.

name: Ynadar Unconventional Package
desc: This design chip is comprised of the more unusual weapon blueprints of Ynadar including its high burst volleycannons to the traditional nuclear warhead mauler.
